name: Cyclobarbital
summary: Cyclobarbital, cyclobarbitol or cyclobarbitone (brand name Phanodorm) is a barbiturate derivative developed in the early 1920s in Germany. It was available in Russia until 2019, marketed and distributed as Reladorm, a fixed-dose combination pairing 100 mg cyclobarbital and 10 mg diazepam indicated for treating insomnia before it was discontinued in 2019.
